scoring_justification: Compute-driven task; raw DFT outputs not submitted, so we cannot recompute defect levels from first principles. Instead we check the agent's extracted numbers against hidden paper gold within tolerances, and verify the required formation energy trend and CBM/VBM k-point coincidence as structural consistency checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for defect levels, formation energies, and boolean fields from the paper's reported tables/figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values in Sections III B and C, Figs. 2(b),4(a),4(b) and text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the published quantitative results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published numbers, serving as authoritative reference for reproduction.

defect_level.description: Energy of lowest donor level below conduction band minimum, in eV

formation_energy.description: Formation energy of the defect, in eV

cbm_vbm_same_kpoint.description: Whether conduction band minimum and valence band maximum are at the same k-point

outputs.description: Final defect properties: lowest donor level, formation energy, and CBM/VBM k-point information for surface, deep internal, and shallow internal VAsVGa complex defects.

output_contract.notes: The formation energy calculation should use standard elemental bulk references for chemical potentials. All values are at zero charge state. The agent is free to choose the hybrid functional mix and exact computational settings, but must report results consistent with the expected physical picture.
